_doc: Tool-gated prompt composition (docs/native-macos-m5.md). A gate whose `tool` is not registered for the agent drops its target: the whole `segment`, or (with `prefix`) every line of that segment whose trimmed text starts with the prefix. Milestones delete entries as their tools land (M6: read/research/pdf/demo/visual; M7: list_sessions). The prompt files themselves stay verbatim copies of src/agent.
